>>> The Electoral College is a system used to elect the President of the United States.  
>>> Each state has a certain number of electors based on its population.  
>>> Voters in each state choose electors who then vote for the president.  
>>> Most states use a "winner-takes-all" approach, giving all their electors to the candidate who wins the popular vote.  
>>> Supporters argue it ensures smaller states have a voice in the election.  
>>> Critics say it can allow a candidate to win the presidency without winning the popular vote.  
>>> Some argue it is outdated and should be replaced with a direct popular vote system.
